recommendations.description: QueryCombination filter at line 1707 deletes Map entries during iteration, risking skipped entries or unpredictable behavior. Collect deletions in array first.
Complex query filtering lacks tests for: error handling, AND/OR strategies, empty results, score consistency, and falsy returns. Production risk.
Line 1967 score calculation lacks null/undefined checks; NaN could propagate. Add: `(rawValue.score || 0) * quality`
Line 1976 Object.assign() risks overwriting critical result fields. Use spread with explicit ordering.
Five high-priority scenarios missing: AND combineWith, error handling, empty results, score validation, falsy return values.
Filter application duplicated at lines 1383 and 1710. Extract common applyFilter() method.
QueryCombination uses inverted logic (delete non-matching). Collect deletions, then delete after iteration for clarity.
Repeated Map.get() calls in makeResult loop. Consider caching for large result sets.
